about.title: About Independent Media Network
about.description: Independent Media Network is a Melbourne company that builds and looks after websites for small businesses. Human run, AI powered.
paragraphs: Independent Media Network Pty Ltd is a small Melbourne company run by Simon Farrugia. We build and run our own websites, from a Victorian travel guide to Australian pay calculators, and now we build them for other businesses too.

Every site is built on the same system we use for our own: fast pages on Cloudflare, Google basics done properly, daily health checks and a dashboard that shows at a glance whether everything is working. What we learn on one site improves all of them.

We're human run and AI powered. AI tools do the drafting, checking and quick edits, which keeps the price fair. Simon plans each site with the owner, checks every page before it goes live and answers every email.
We keep the offer simple on purpose: one plan, no setup fee, no lock-in contract, two change rounds a month and clear terms. If a job is bigger than a change, we say so and quote it first.

contact.title: Contact us
contact.description: Questions about a website for your business? Email Independent Media Network or send a message. We reply within two business days.
contact.lede: Questions first? Send a message or email us. A person reads every one and replies within two business days.

sections.h: What to put in your message
p: Asking about a website for your business? Tell us your business name, what you do and the area you work in, and whether you already have a domain name or an old website. That's enough for us to tell you plainly whether we're a good fit and what your site would include.
Already a client? Send change requests to the same address, with all your edits together in one email. That counts as one change round, and you get 2 a month in your plan.

Simon reads every message and replies within two business days. If a website sounds right for you, the next step is a private preview: your new home page and key pages built from what you already publish, so you can see it before you decide anything.
There's no sales call you have to sit through and no obligation. If what you need is bigger than our one plan, we'll say so and quote it first.

privacy-policy.title: Privacy policy
privacy-policy.description: What Independent Media Network collects, why, and who sees it.
paragraphs: Independent Media Network Pty Ltd (ABN 89 640 199 935, Melbourne, Australia) runs this website. This policy explains what we collect and why.

When you fill in a form, we collect the details you give us: your name, email, phone (optional), business name, your website (if you have one) and your message. We use them only to reply to you and, if you go ahead, to build and look after your website.

If you use our free website check (imnetwork.com.au/labs/website-check), we open the public page you type in, and a sample of its links, to build your report. We save the report (the website address and its results) at check.imnetwork.com.au so you get a link you can share. We don't save your name or email unless you send us the form afterwards. Your internet address is kept for one day, only to limit how many checks one person can run.

Emails we send to businesses can include a tiny image and tracked links (through go.imnetwork.com.au), which tell us if the email was opened or a link was clicked, and roughly where from. Every first email has a one-line way to say no thanks, and we don't contact you again after that.
We don't sell or rent your details, and we don't add you to mailing lists.

For clients, we store the content and settings of your website and, if you choose the dashboard, visit and Google search counts for your site. These are counts, not information about who your visitors are.

To see, correct or delete what we hold about you, email hello@imnetwork.com.au. If you're not happy with how we've handled your information, you can contact the Office of the Australian Information Commissioner (oaic.gov.au).

terms.title: Terms of service
terms.description: The terms for Independent Media Network's website plan: what's included, billing, changes, cancelling and who owns what.

sections.h: Who we are and when these terms apply
p: These terms are between your business ("you") and Independent Media Network Pty Ltd, ABN 89 640 199 935 ("IMN", "we"), Melbourne, Victoria. They apply from when you accept a quote, pay, or tell us in writing to go ahead with the website plan, and they're the whole agreement between us about it. Notices can be sent by email: ours to hello@imnetwork.com.au, yours to the email you gave us.

If you take a free website, we build a simple site from one of our industry templates, using information you publish and give us. It's hosted on an IMN address (such as yourbusiness.imnetwork.com.au) and shows a small "Website by IMN" link, which stays in place.

A free website doesn't include change rounds, support, a dashboard, a custom domain or our guarantee. We may update the template, fix errors or correct details to keep it accurate. You can ask us to take it down at any time. We may take a free website down with 30 days' notice by email, or straight away under "Content we won't host".

"Your part", "Who owns what", "Content we won't host", "Our part", "Privacy and confidentiality", "Liability" and "Changes, transfers and law" apply to free websites too. The rest of these terms apply once you choose the website plan, which you can do at any time.

The website plan includes: building your website (up to 5 pages), hosting, an SSL certificate, backups of every version, Google basics (page titles, descriptions, a sitemap and Google Search Console), daily uptime checks and regular site health checks, a private dashboard, and 2 change rounds a month.

A change round is up to 30 minutes of work on small updates to existing pages, sent together in one email. Unused rounds don't carry over. Extra rounds cost $50 + GST each. Extra pages beyond the first 5 cost $99 + GST each, once. Redesigns and bigger jobs are quoted first, and we don't start them without your written OK.

Your domain name and its yearly fee, email hosting or email accounts, social media, paid advertising, photography, third-party subscriptions (such as booking or shop software), and fixing problems caused by other providers. We're happy to quote for any of these.

We build from the information, words and images you give us and send you a private preview. You can ask for reasonable changes to the preview before it goes live. If you don't reply to a preview or change for 14 days after we've followed it up, we may treat it as approved. Your site goes live when you approve it.
The plan costs $99 + GST a month. There's no setup fee: building your site is part of the plan. Prices are in Australian dollars and exclude GST unless we say otherwise.

Monthly fees are charged in advance by card, starting the day your site goes live. We send a tax invoice for every payment. If a payment fails, we'll tell you and try again. If it's still unpaid 14 days after we tell you, we may pause your site until it's paid, and after a further 30 days we may end the plan.
We'll give you at least 30 days' written notice of any price change, and you can cancel before it starts.

Live in 7 days: if your site isn't live within 7 days of your go-ahead, your first month is free. The 7 days start once you've told us to go ahead, paid your first month, and given us what we need to put it live (your details and access to your web address, or approval to buy one for you). Delays caused by waiting on you, your domain provider or anything outside our control don't count.

30-day money-back: if you're not happy with your site for any reason within 30 days of your first payment, email us and we'll refund your first month in full and take the site down. You don't need to give a reason.

Either way, the most we refund is your first month's fee, once per business. A refund under the guarantee ends the plan. These promises are in addition to your rights under the Australian Consumer Law.

There's no lock-in contract. Plans are month to month: tell us by email before your next billing date and we won't charge you again. Your site stays live until the end of the month you've paid for. Apart from our guarantee below, fees already paid aren't refunded for part months, except where the law requires it.

We can end the plan with 30 days' written notice for any reason, and straight away if you seriously or repeatedly break these terms. If we end it without cause, we refund any fees paid for time after it ends.
When the plan ends and everything owing is paid, we send you a copy of your site's files and help you point your domain somewhere else, at no charge.

You own your domain name, your business name and logo, and the words and photos you give us. Words and images we create for your site become yours once they're paid for. We own our system, code, design templates and tools, and give you a permanent licence to use the site files we hand over for your own business. You let us use your content to build, host and promote your site, and to show your site in our portfolio unless you ask us not to.

You confirm that the information on your site is accurate and lawful, that you have the right to use the words, photos and logos you give us, and that your site won't be used for anything illegal, misleading or harmful. Please check your preview and every change, and tell us if something's wrong.

You're responsible for your business's own legal obligations on your site, such as prices, claims about your products and services, and any licences your industry needs. If someone makes a claim against us because of content you supplied or asked us to publish, you agree to cover our reasonable costs of dealing with it.

We may refuse, or take down, content that we reasonably believe is unlawful, infringes someone's rights, or could harm others. If we need to, we'll tell you why and give you a chance to fix it, unless it's urgent.

We take reasonable care to keep your site online, secure and backed up, and we reply to emails within two business days. We rely on hosting and other providers (such as Cloudflare and Google), so sites can occasionally be unavailable for reasons outside our control; we'll fix anything on our side as quickly as we can.
We help your site follow Google's basics, but no one can promise rankings, visitors, enquiries or sales, and we don't.

We use AI tools to draft pages, check sites and make changes. A person reviews every page before it goes live and every change before it's published. Our system learns from every site we run so that improvements found on one can be applied to others. We share what we learn, never your content, data or your customers' details.

We handle your details as set out in our privacy policy. Messages your customers send through your site's forms are kept only to pass them on to you and to look after your site. We keep your business information confidential, except where we need to share it with our providers to run your site or the law requires it.

Nothing in these terms takes away rights you have under the Australian Consumer Law. Where we're allowed to, we limit our liability for a failure to meet a consumer guarantee to supplying the services again or paying for them to be supplied again.

As far as the law allows, our total liability to you for anything to do with the plan is limited to the fees you paid us in the 3 months before the claim, and neither of us is liable to the other for indirect losses such as lost profits, revenue or data. Neither of us is responsible for delays caused by events outside our reasonable control.

We may update these terms. We'll email you at least 30 days before a change that affects you, and you can cancel before it applies. We may transfer this agreement to a business that takes over IMN's websites, and we'll tell you if we do. These terms are governed by the laws of Victoria, Australia, and both of us can bring proceedings in its courts.

affiliate-disclosure.title: Affiliate disclosure
affiliate-disclosure.description: How Independent Media Network earns from affiliate links on IMN Labs pages, and what that means for you.
paragraphs: Independent Media Network Pty Ltd (ABN 89 640 199 935, Melbourne) earns most of its money from website subscriptions. Some pages in IMN Labs, the section where we test new ideas, may also carry affiliate links.

An affiliate link means that if you click through and buy, the shop may pay us a small commission. You pay the same price either way. Affiliate links are marked as sponsored links in the page code, and buttons that lead to a shop say where they go.

Commissions never decide what we say. Rankings, price bands and comparisons are built from published prices and other facts we can check, each with the date we checked it. A shop can't pay to be listed, moved up or described differently.
We don't book or sell anything ourselves. Prices and stock can change after we check them, so confirm the details on the seller's site before you buy.
Questions about a link or a page? Email hello@imnetwork.com.au.
